post_title: The townhouse is $35K cheaper. Is it the better rental?
caption:
The townhouse is $35K cheaper. Better rental? 🏘️

A lower price can hide a higher monthly bill. Head to head:

• Price: $240K vs $275K. Townhouse wins.
• HOA dues: $325 vs $0 a month. House wins.
• Rent: $2,100 vs $2,350. House wins.
• Cash flow: −$91 vs +$65 a month. House wins, 3–1.

Cheaper isn't always cheaper. Always check the HOA.

Example numbers: 25% down, 7% 30-year, expenses at 23% of rent (18% for the townhouse because the HOA covers the exterior).
